newsitem.title: USA: Innovasive gets FDA nod on suture fasteners.
newsitem.headline: Innovasive gets FDA nod on suture fasteners.

text.p: Innovasive Devices Inc said Wednesday it had received clearance from the Food and Drug Administration to market its 3.5 mm ROC and ROC XS suture fasteners for use in treating female urinary incontinence due to urethral hypermobility.

The company said it recognizes that the treatment of urinary incontinence is outside the realm of its primary focus, the sports medicine/arthroscopy market, and it is pursuing a strategic partner with a strong presence in urology and gynecology to assist it in marketing the product.
Innovasive makes and sells proprietary tissue repair systems that facilitate the repair of soft tissue injuries.
